title: Reconstruct the counit square from the supplied Brown square
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a normed finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a field $k$ whose characteristic is prime and different from $\ell$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$, a $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$, and a specified normalized compact-support comparison family $C$ [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. Use the actual functors, maps, supplied pairs, and normalized Brown data of [def-pur-reconstructed-refinement-data]. Let $w:c\to d$ be a refinement, $D_1,D_2$ normalized Brown packages, $L$ an integral object on $Y$, and $A_1,A_2$ supplied systems over $L$. Let $s:A_2.\operatorname{system}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_1.\operatorname{system}$ satisfy $\theta_1\circ s=\rho_{12}\circ\theta_2$, where $\rho_{12}$ is the actual counit-preserving Brown mate. Write $\bar s$ for the total-limit reconstruction, $t_i:P_i(A_i.\operatorname{object})\to L$ for the traces obtained by applying the published representing Hom bijections to identities, and $q:P_1\xrightarrow{\sim}P_2$ for the inverse of the actual integral refinement map. Then $t_1\circ P_1(\bar s)=t_2\circ q_{A_2.\operatorname{object}}$. Only this integral counit square is asserted.

proof.text:
let e_i be the actual reduction/limit counit on the supplied systems.
Naturality gives R(sbar) followed by e_1 equal to e_2 followed by s.
The Brown Hom formula and the definition of mate give its counit equation.
Apply compact support to the supplied theta square, use that equation and
naturality of the constructed system comparison. Insert these identities in
PublishedFamily.trace_reduction for both traces, along with naturality of alpha
and its actual refinement square. The two reductions of the desired integral
maps now agree. Reduction on derived-complete objects is fully faithful by the
normalized reconstruction adjunction; hence the integral maps agree. Coordinate
equivalence preserves this calculation, including its counit factors.

lean.statement:
theorem reconstructedRefinementTraceSquare :
    ∀ (c d : Compactification f)
    (D₁ : At l E k C X Y f c) (D₂ : At l E k C X Y f d) (w : c.Refinement d)
    (L : CondensedERealization.Integral l E Y.scheme)
    (A₁ : D₁.Supplied L) (A₂ : D₂.Supplied L) (s : A₂.system ≅ A₁.system),
    s.hom ≫ (D₁.pair L A₁).theta.hom =
      (D₂.pair L A₂).theta.hom ≫ mate D₁ D₂ w L A₁ A₂ →
    (support l E k C X Y f c).map (reconstructedMap D₁ D₂ L A₁ A₂ s.hom) ≫
      D₁.trace L A₁ =
        (comparison l E k C X Y f w).hom.app A₂.object ≫ D₂.trace L A₂
